title: Gentle step landscapes
notes: First routes in all three bands: P1-2; add the forced-ramp question P3 when children can check every neighboring jump. On return, K-1 can build the seven-site landscapes (P5) or change one marker per move with a partner checking each jump (P6) and invent clues on the page 6 board (P7). Grades 2-3 can optimize totals (P5), then make partner clues or a distance rule (P6-7). Grades 4-5 can build pointwise envelopes (P5), shade allowed heights around one clue and around two (P6), and justify completion from all pairwise bounds (P7). Keep zero visible and retain child-chosen constructions before presenting a general recipe.
